exposure: gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) treated with diet only (GDM G1)
gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) treated with diet and insulin therapy (GDM G2)
birth after COVID-19 pandemic outbreak in 2020
outcome: need for support in adaptation period
cohort: The study analyzed medical records of 646 newborns born at term or near term between 2017 and 2021 to mothers with gestational diabetes mellitus.
finding: Neonates born to mothers with GDM G1 and GDM G2 differed significantly in hospitalisation length, incidence of cardiological abnormalities, and method of feeding, while neonates born in 2020 (during the COVID-19 pandemic outbreak) more often required adaptation support and were diagnosed with birth defects and other complications.
